stories.headline: Weymouth moved five points clear at the top, with three games in hand on second…
stories.body: Weymouth moved five points clear at the top, with three games in hand on second place Westbury United, with a 2-0 win over Exmouth Town . Tom Bearwish opened the scoring on 14 minutes before Frankie Monk's 91st minute finish sealed the three points, meaning Weymouth have won 14 of their 16 league matches this season.
stories.source_title: Dyno-Rod Round-Up | Waltham Abbey continue to bang in the goals, Flackwell Heath pick up a big three points, and Worcester City make it four straight wins
stories.author: Jack Phillips

stories.headline: The points were shared in our other games in the Division One South as Hungerford…
stories.body: The points were shared in our other games in the Division One South as Hungerford Town drew 1-1 with Larkhall Athletic on Charlie Griffin's first game in charge of Larkhall , and Falmouth Town and Portland United drawing 2-2.

stories.headline: Westbury United made it six wins in a row, moving two points behind Weymouth, having…
stories.body: Westbury United made it six wins in a row, moving two points behind Weymouth, having played four games extra, following a 1-2 win at Barnstaple Town , with an 85th minute Jake Andrews winner securing the three points for the White Horse Men.
stories.source_title: Dyno-Rod Round-Up | Evesham United win an eight goal thriller while Westbury United make it six wins in a row and Melksham Town win their third straight match
stories.author: Jack Phillips

stories.headline: Exmouth Town picked up back-to-back wins, putting five past bottom of the table, and manageress…
stories.body: Exmouth Town picked up back-to-back wins, putting five past bottom of the table, and manageress Bristol Manor Farm in a 5-0 win, with braces from Thomas Chastey and Callum Shipton, James Watts-Barciela also getting on the scoresheet.

stories.headline: Melksham Town made it three straight wins with a 2-4 victory at Slimbridge to move…
stories.body: Melksham Town made it three straight wins with a 2-4 victory at Slimbridge to move them up to 16th, scoring 11 goals across those three wins. Mark Cooper opened the scoring for the Stags, Dawid Regula and Thomas Dowell also getting on the scoresheet in the first-half as they went in 0-3 at the break.

stories.headline: But the one goal margin only lasted five minutes as Regula got his second of…
stories.body: But the one goal margin only lasted five minutes as Regula got his second of the afternoon in the 80th to seal the win, which leaves Slimbridge a place and two points inside the relegation zone.
